question: In January 2022, the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change announced the 'Action Plan for Introduction of □( ) in India', under which it has been decided to reintroduce the extinct species in the country.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Himalayan Quail**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Himalayan Quail** (Ophrysia superciliosa) is a bird species that was last seen in 1876 in the western Himalayas near Mussoorie, India.
 
• This species is categorized as **Critically Endangered (Possibly Extinct)** by the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN).
 
• The Himalayan Quail was primarily found in the sub-Himalayan regions, and its habitat loss is one of the significant reasons for its decline.
 
• Efforts to reintroduce this species aim to restore biodiversity and enhance the ecological balance in its native habitat.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change:**

 
 
• This ministry is responsible for the planning, promotion, coordination, and overseeing the implementation of environmental and forestry policies and programs in India.
 
• It aims to protect and improve the environment and the living conditions of the people.
 
 
 
• **Reintroduction Programs:**
 
 
• Reintroduction programs involve the release of species into an area where they have been extirpated or extinct.
 
• The objective is to restore a viable, free-ranging population of the species in its natural habitat.
 
• Such programs require careful planning, including habitat assessment, ensuring genetic diversity, and post-release monitoring.
 
 
 
• **Biodiversity Conservation:**
 
 
• Biodiversity conservation is crucial for maintaining ecological balance and the health of ecosystems.
 
• It includes protecting species, their habitats, and ecosystems from excessive exploitation and destruction.
 
• Conservation efforts help in sustaining the natural resources that humans depend on for survival.
 
 
 
• **International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN):**
 
 
• The IUCN is a global authority on the status of the natural world and the measures needed to safeguard it.
 
• It maintains the Red List of Threatened Species, which assesses the conservation status of species worldwide.
 
• The IUCN Red List provides critical information for conservation actions and policy decisions.
